DAVE'S QUALITY FENCING — MELBOURNE'S #1 FENCING TEAM!!

Thanks for checking us out. My name's Dave and I've been in the fencing game for over 27 years now,
started with my old man back in the day when we were doing paling fences out in the eastern suburbs
with nothing but a shovel and a wheelbarrow. These days we've got three trucks, a bobcat, an auger,
and a team of blokes I'd trust with my own house. We're a family business — my son Jarrod came on
about six years ago and he runs most of the Colorbond side of things now.

WHAT WE DO

We do the lot mate. Timber paling fences, Colorbond, aluminium slat fencing, glass pool fencing,
frameless glass, semi-frameless, chainmesh, security fencing, rural fencing, post and rail, picket
fences, privacy screens, retaining walls, gates of all descriptions, automatic gates, intercoms,
you name it. If it stands up and keeps things in or out, we build it.

We use only the best materials. Our timber is all H4 treated pine or premium merbau depending on
what you're after, our Colorbond is genuine BlueScope, and we don't cut corners on the concrete
either. A lot of the cheaper mobs will use 200mm footings — we go deeper because we know what
Melbourne clay does in summer.

PRICING

Look, every job's different, that's the honest truth. A fence on a flat block with easy access is a
totally different beast to a fence on a slope with no side gate. So the only way to get a proper
price is to have us out for a look.

That said, as a rough guide:

Timber paling — anywhere from $80 to $130 per metre depending on height, timber and site.
Colorbond — POA, but very competitive, give us a bell.
Aluminium slat — starts from about $150ish
Glass pool fencing — POA (depends entirely on the glass and the spigots)
Chainmesh — cheap as chips, from $50
Rural — call for pricing, depends how many k's of it you want.

Heights: we do everything from 900 right up to 2400 if you need it. Most people go 1800 which is the
standard. We can do 6ft or 1.8, same thing really. Front fences usually 1.2 or 1500 depending on
council.

Gates are extra of course, depends on the size and whether you want it motorised.

We can also take away your old fence for you and dispose of it properly — a lot of the young fellas
starting out will just leave it in a pile on your nature strip, we're not like that.

Steep blocks and rocky ground do cost a bit more, that's just the reality of it, but we'll always be
upfront with you about that at the quote.

WHERE WE WORK

All over Melbourne and surrounds. We've done jobs from Werribee to Lilydale and everywhere in
between. If you're a bit further out just ask, we've been known to travel for the right job.

GET IN TOUCH

Give us a ring or flick us a message and we'll get out to you usually within the week. Ask for Dave
or Jarrod. We're old school — we'd rather have a chat about your job than send you a computer
generated quote.

CHEERS AND THANKS FOR YOUR TIME!
